title: Bazel CI is NPE-ing in AttributeContainer

labels.name: P0
labels.description: This is an emergency and more important than other current work. (Assignee required)

body:
I haven't verified, but I'm guessing this was caused by 178a3dfda8bf72abf22758597a90a4afb8eed181. See, e.g., http://ci.bazel.io/job/Bazel/JAVA_VERSION=1.8,PLATFORM_NAME=linux-x86_64/524/console.
